## Projects

**Personal projects** (data science)

- **[Facial Expression Model Audit](projects/facial-expression-audit/index.qmd)** (in progress) — Audited a public Hugging Face facial expression classifier on external data without retraining. Found that a preprocessing mismatch caused most errors; changing only the input crop raised accuracy from 22.6% to 45.3%.
- **[Ttareungi: Predicting Bike Shortages](projects/ttareungi/index.qmd)** (in progress) — Predicting station-level shortages in Seoul's public bike system from 1.7M rental records and weather data. Lag and weather features improved AUC from 0.66 to 0.73.

**Competition & club projects** (web)

- **[MatchplanXI](projects/matchplanxi/index.qmd)** — Competition entry. 2026 World Cup tactics simulator covering all 48 national teams. TypeScript, React, Vite.
- **[Coursepic](projects/coursepic/index.qmd)** — University club industry project. Real-time collaborative date-course planner with no sign-up. Next.js, Supabase, Kakao Maps.
